title: Anyone can use miyagi-cloud as free AI
solution: Measure one real lesson, then server-side dollar caps per install and per user, a daily new-install cap, a runtime kill switch and alerts, plus the fixes in Michael's private notes.

title: No provider-side spend caps or alerts
solution: Today: prepaid credit with auto-reload off as the one hard stop, a dedicated Anthropic workspace with limits and alerts, a Gemini cap, and correct prices in the proxy.

title: Lesson builds through miyagi-cloud likely fail
solution: Raise the proxy's 4096-token cap (or lower the builder's ask) now with R02 as the backstop, and make the model allowlist match the Gemini decision.

title: The launch build is untested: never installed on a clean Mac, much of it never run in Electron, no tests in CI
solution: Freeze a launch SHA, make CI run the tests, publish a versioned v2 build, and run Test 1 plus a pass over every UNVERIFIED feature on clean macOS 15, 26 and 27.

title: Learners aren't told before capture that their screen and code go to Anthropic, and nothing says it's AI
solution: A plain consent screen before the Screen Recording prompt that says the whole screen goes to Anthropic, an "AI, can be wrong" line, and the providers named in the app and on the site.

title: No live privacy policy or terms, while the app says users accept them
solution: Publish the corrected drafts at /privacy and /terms, fix the app's dead links and its Delete-my-data wording, add an "I agree" step, and have a lawyer read them before public launch.

title: Placeholder: VS Code companion configuration and engine handling of learner keys
solution: Apply the fixes in Michael's private notes, ship companion 0.0.7, and hide own-key fields until the engine fix ships.

title: No way to get a fix to people who installed
solution: Versioned releases from one publisher, the update card, and a minimum-version answer from the cloud, all in the first build outsiders install.

title: The founders are minors with no company, so their families carry the liability and the accounts have no proper holder
solution: Freeze and list accounts today; form a manager-managed LLC with a parent as manager, then move every account into it with the parent signing for it.

title: Correct work gets "Not yet", then the coach says to change working code
solution: Run the beta on curated lessons and count false fails; grade runs on the newest output, check shape not literals, and let the coach say "your code works".

title: One-click model-written commands from a stranger's tutorial, and a shared cache that could feed them
solution: Show each command and ask first, allow-list normal commands, block deletes, sudo and pipe-to-shell, install only catalog packages, and keep the shared cache out of the launch build.

title: New installs may be refused on launch day
solution: Test the client-IP handling on staging, raise the per-network install limit with plain copy, and ship the first build on api.miyagi.study with net.fetch.

title: Gemini's terms bar under-18 users and under-18 account holders
solution: Decide today. Recommended: Claude only for everyone at launch, Gemini off in the cloud and in Settings, keeping the 13+ gate.

title: Progress and settings get lost
solution: Move durable choices into main prefs, make Continue restore the saved step without moving files, and move the hero lesson out of the engine tree.

title: The Mac app is unsigned
solution: Launch unsigned only if Test 1 passes on macOS 26 and 27 and a first-launch capture check ships; sign once the LLC holds an Apple organization account.

title: miyagi-cloud capacity, provider tiers and plan
solution: Confirm Starter with the disk, raise the Anthropic tier, lift the connection limits, lighten scene looks and load-test before launch.

title: The coach now searches DuckDuckGo and reads web pages by default, and nothing discloses it
solution: Turn the coach's web search off in the launch build (COACH_WEB=0), or disclose it, send an honest user agent and treat fetched pages as untrusted.

title: Screen capture takes more than the lesson needs
solution: Exclude private and messaging apps on every capture path and scrub secrets from code and open files; capture only the editor and tutorial windows after launch.

title: Live on the site now: a Windows download that can't run a lesson, and an old app build at /live/
solution: Today: take the Windows button off the site ("mac only for now"), mark the windows release Mac-only, and delete /live/.

title: Google sign-in and Supabase aren't launch-ready
solution: Publish the Google app, check the Supabase console, fix the sign-in copy and button, and brand the consent screen with a custom domain or a desktop client.

title: No age gate, teen-safety or crisis safeguards
solution: A neutral age gate before sign-in and before the install token is minted, teen defaults, a 988 crisis card, Anthropic's child-safety prompt and a public COPPA statement.

title: The engine scrapes YouTube for transcripts
solution: Recommended: keep the on-device fetch with limits (no server scraping, no spoofed agent, nothing stored) after a lawyer's read; build toward creator captions.

title: Name collision with Miyagi Labs, and Karate Kid cues
solution: Drop every Karate Kid cue now and get a clearance opinion before the public post; rebrand before posting if it comes back high-risk.

title: No insurance, so the families pay for any defense
solution: After the LLC exists, buy a tech E&O, cyber and media policy before the public post, with no AI or wrongful-collection exclusion, disclosing teens and screen capture.

title: Nobody holds clean title to miyagi's code
solution: Sign an interim founders' agreement this week; with the LLC, a present-tense IP assignment with vesting, and assignments or rewrites for outside contributions.

title: One personal account controls what every install is offered, and nothing tells a real download from a fake
solution: Today: immutable releases, a passkey and a single-repo token; then pin the update card's installer URL and list one official link with SHA-256s on miyagi.study.

title: One shared Anthropic key: a few abusive users could get miyagi suspended for everyone
solution: Tag every proxied call with an anonymous per-install metadata.user_id, keep free-text prompts on coding, and plan for a suspended key.

title: Delete my data doesn't delete, and nothing can be deleted on the server
solution: A full app erase, DELETE /v1/me with Supabase user deletion, retention limits and unlink on sign-out (the honest button copy is in R06).

title: Spinners and builds with no way out
solution: A Check watchdog on top of the new socket heartbeat, a hard deadline on every model call and the whole build, and progress by stage.

title: Raw or wrong errors when the cloud or a provider fails
solution: Map every cloud and provider failure to one calm card, keep minting while paused, and retry the first mint with backoff.

title: First run on a real student's Mac
solution: Point the network probe at the cloud host, suggest a lesson that can't fail, make Accessibility optional, and fix the VS Code, venv and proxy cases.

title: Wrong work marked right
solution: The judge can never overrule a failing machine check (before launch); mask comments and grade the newest run (after).

title: Local access hardening for the engine, companion and app (mostly placeholder)
solution: Apply the fixes in Michael's private notes, isolate the YouTube player from the app bridge, and bump Electron to the latest 45.x.

title: No support, security or privacy contact
solution: Domain email to a shared inbox, private vulnerability reporting, security.txt and SECURITY.md, a no-upload bug form, /help and a rehearsed runbook.

title: Launch-day blindness: no crash, usage or uptime signal
solution: Uptime monitors today, server-side counters with no content, an opt-in fixed-schema crash endpoint, and no SDK without the allowlist config.

title: Copy over-promises, the demo is scripted, and it can read as a cheating tool
solution: Say exactly what works today, add "can be wrong" and "beta", record one honest unedited take, and position it as checking work, never doing it.

title: macOS permission prompts: the monthly re-ask and the 27.3 change
solution: Pause the lesson with a plain card when macOS re-asks, name the monthly alert in onboarding, and rewrite the Accessibility step for 27.3.

title: The download code gate
solution: Keep it for the private beta and remove it on public launch morning, once the spend controls are live.

title: Personal accounts are single points of failure
solution: Verify miyagi.study on GitHub Pages, put Porkbun on 2FA and auto-renew, and give a second person Render access.

title: Where miyagi is offered
solution: Recommended: US first, blocking the EEA, UK, Switzerland and Anthropic's unsupported regions at the proxy until there's an entity.

title: Creators' content in the public repo, and no DMCA agent
solution: Take third-party lesson content out of the repo, register a DMCA agent with a takedown policy, and credit the creator in every lesson.

title: The site doesn't say what miyagi is, and phones get desktop downloads
solution: One plain hero sentence, a desktop-app note on phones, the YouTube embed on click only, and integrity hashes on CDN imports.

title: Launch channel rules
solution: Post from an account that passes /showlim, write every post and reply by hand, never ask for votes, and stagger HN and Product Hunt.

title: The engine keeps running with no UI
solution: Check on a Mac that capture stops when the app dies, make the engine exit with its parent, and have the app stop the group at quit.

title: Local logs keep questions, code and paths forever
solution: Private file modes, a rotated metadata-only log, ORCH_RECORD=0 in shipped builds, and a scrubbed Copy details.

title: Keep secrets out of the repo and builds
solution: Confirm secret scanning and push protection, run gitleaks in CI, refuse secret Supabase keys at build time, and scan every release asset.

title: Fixed ports 8787 and 47217
solution: Name the app holding port 8787 and let Retry work without a relaunch; choose ports at launch later.

title: No license choice and no third-party notices
solution: Choose a license on purpose, generate third-party notices at build time, ship OFL.txt, and check the bundled Python for GPL code.

title: Site polish: load weight, accessibility, a second download button
solution: Words before 3D, darker small text and a skip link, and a download block after the story.
